requirement.description: The NotifyResend constructor is missing the from_email parameter in its signature, causing TypeError when instantiating objects with URL parsing.
requirement.contract: The NotifyResend.__init__ method must accept from_email as a required parameter to match the expected interface and allow instantiation from URL parsing.

requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin's URL formatting logic incorrectly handles user targets, not properly converting user names to the expected format (@user) in privacy URLs.
requirement.contract: The url() method must properly format user targets to start with '@' symbol for privacy URLs to match expected format in tests.

requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin is not correctly implementing group expansion and deduplication logic for targets, causing incorrect HTTP request counts and validation failures.
requirement.contract: The send() method must correctly expand group targets, resolve user lists, and properly deduplicate users to match expected behavior in test cases.

requirement.description: The SendGrid plugin's URL validation logic is inconsistent with expected behavior, specifically regarding notify_response behavior for invalid email addresses.
requirement.contract: The send() method must return False when email validation fails and no valid targets exist, matching expected test behavior.

requirement.description: The Slack plugin's URL parsing logic is not correctly handling various URL formats and target specifications, causing assertion failures in URL validation tests.
requirement.contract: The parse_url() method must correctly parse all supported URL formats and extract targets properly to match expected test outcomes.
